items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Pam can ask you questions... What do you want to know, Pam, honey? [SPEAKER_03] Well, it's just good listening and having you tell me about all these photographs.

ctx.x: Come on, Pam. Okay. Okay. Yeah. Why don't you turn on that light over there, Dick?
All right, now I'll turn the machine around so you can see... And move the microphone in close. We can see if we're talking loud or not.
